title: Morning Robotics Scan
report:
## Meta Data Center Robots

### The Breakthrough
Meta is piloting a suite of robots—including Kinova Gen3 arms, ABB manipulators, and a minimalist finger actuator—to autonomously plug cables, reset servers, and perform other chores inside its data centers, showcasing a growing toolbox for large‑scale infrastructure automation.

### The Caveats
The claim that the robots could replace up to 80% of workers is unsubstantiated, as Meta provides no quantitative performance data or comparison to human labor efficiency.

## Real-Time Task-Space Control for Pneumatic Soft Actuators

### The Breakthrough
The authors present a real‑time task‑space feedback framework that uses a discrete elastic‑rod model and a quasi‑static inverse feedforward controller to achieve millimeter‑level accuracy (1.5‑2.3 mm RMSE at low speed, 5.5‑12.4 mm RMSE at 1‑2 Hz) on three pneumatic soft actuators across five tasks, demonstrating precise, moderate‑bandwidth control of soft robots.

### The Caveats
The paper reports millimeter‑level accuracy but provides no comparison against any existing soft‑robot control baselines, so the claimed improvement over prior methods is unverified.

## Tensegrity Continuum Reconfigurable Robots

### The Breakthrough
A modular robot combines tensegrity‑based compliant bodies with claw‑type docking, allowing each unit to act independently or reconfigure into chains, loops, or branched structures for coordinated manipulation and locomotion, with real‑world demos of cooperative transport and multimodal movement.

### The Caveats
The paper presents only qualitative real‑world demos and offers no quantitative comparison to existing modular or continuum robots, leaving its claimed versatility unsubstantiated.

## Microduck Open-Source RL Duck Robot

### The Breakthrough
Hugging Face released the 25 cm Microduck, a $399 duck‑shaped robot equipped with camera, lidar, and IMUs, bundled with a full reinforcement‑learning pipeline that trains behaviors in simulation and deploys them directly on the hardware.

### The Caveats
The announcement provides no performance data, benchmarks, or real‑world testing, so the claim that Microduck is a general physical‑AI platform remains unverified.

## FlashVLA Streaming Action Decoding

### The Breakthrough
FlashVLA introduces a streaming buffer of action chunks and chunk‑wise causal attention, enabling vision‑language‑action models to emit one action chunk per inference step and achieve over 30 Hz control on a single GPU while maintaining strong task performance.

### The Caveats
The work reports high‑frequency, low‑latency inference but provides no comparison to existing VLA inference baselines, leaving the novelty of the speed and performance gains unverified.

## Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning Benchmark

### The Breakthrough
The authors define ESRP, an egocentric long‑horizon rearrangement task and release ESRP‑Bench with ~5.4k scene pairs and 8.2k objects, showing that current planning and learning baselines struggle on this realistic simulation benchmark.

### The Caveats
The reported difficulty and benchmark results are based solely on simulated OmniGibson runs, with no real‑world robot experiments or sensor‑noise testing, leaving it unclear whether the findings transfer to actual embodied settings.

## FERAL-AI Local-First Runtime

### The Breakthrough
FERAL‑AI provides a local‑first AI runtime with a four‑tier memory store (lexical search, vector embeddings, knowledge graph) and policy‑gated execution, enabling persistent multi‑layer memory and cross‑machine state replication for personal robotics projects.

### The Caveats
The repository provides no formal evaluation or baseline comparisons, so the claimed local‑brain capabilities are unverified.

## SpawnDev.ILGPU.ML Hardware-Agnostic .NET ML Library

### The Breakthrough
SpawnDev.ILGPU.ML compiles C# ML kernels to run on CUDA, OpenCL, WebGPU, WebGL, Wasm, and CPU, offering a single codebase for ONNX, TFLite, GGUF, SafeTensors, PyTorch, and CoreML models, with demos including ~51 tokens‑per‑second LLM decoding on RTX 4070.

### The Caveats
The library claims hardware‑agnostic inference across six backends but offers no systematic performance comparison among them, relying only on correctness checks against ONNX Runtime.

### Priority
The Meta data‑center robot deployment is the most compelling story because it demonstrates large‑scale, real‑world robotics automation in a critical infrastructure setting.

### One action
Track Meta’s upcoming performance metrics releases to gauge the true impact of data‑center robot automation.

### What to watch
Both the soft‑actuator task‑space controller and the tensegrity continuum robots push compliant robotics forward—one focuses on precise model‑based control of soft pneumatic limbs, while the other showcases modular reconfiguration for cooperative tasks. Future work comparing their accuracy, speed, and adaptability will clarify the trade‑offs between soft‑actuated precision and modular stiffness.
